how: Champion when the held record opens.

won.source: The 27 July 2009 preview puts the Bunkhouse Brawl "a week away"; the 10 August results call him the "newly crowned heavyweight champion" and the other Brawl finalist is Samuel Hessingstock. The Brawl itself is not among the held pages, so the day is the one that week implies.

title: sccw-simcoe-2009-barbaric
label: Jay Jerzey

won.source: Between the 27 July 2009 card and the 10 August results, which call him the Barbaric title holder: the 12 August news says he won the belt in what the fed called the most bloody and brutal match in its history, against Patrick McCarthy. The held pages do not say on which card; the eWrestling Encyclopedia's Barbaric page (secondary) gives 3 August 2009, the Bunkhouse Brawl's week.

how: Won the Barbaric title from Patrick McCarthy in what the fed called the bloodiest match in its history.
